title: Efficacy and Safety of an Indian Bevacizumab BIOSimilar (BEVATAS) for Retinal Vein Occlusion (BIOS-RVO Study)

license.statement: Dove Medical Press licence incorporating CC BY-NC 3.0 (unported) (article <license>); non-commercial, so private

condition: Treatment-naive macular edema due to retinal vein occlusion (branch and central), consecutive patients June 2022 to August 2023, single tertiary centre in India; retrospective interventional single-agent study, one eye per patient

groups.agent: bevacizumab biosimilar (Bevatas) intravitreal, three monthly loading doses then PRN
groups.description: Baseline diagnostic subgroup: branch retinal vein occlusion

groups.agent: bevacizumab biosimilar (Bevatas) intravitreal, three monthly loading doses then PRN
groups.description: Baseline diagnostic subgroup: central retinal vein occlusion

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 3 row 3, BRVO Mean ± SD column)
series.notes: Central macular thickness (CMT) by Topcon Maestro2 OCT, no subfield definition; Table 3 header 'Mean ± SD'; visits at 3, 6 and 12 months (± 2 weeks) after the initiation of therapy (nominal times; '1 year' = month 12); per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 3 row 3, CRVO Mean ± SD column)
series.notes: Central macular thickness (CMT) by Topcon Maestro2 OCT, no subfield definition; Table 3 header 'Mean ± SD'; visits at 3, 6 and 12 months (± 2 weeks) after the initiation of therapy (nominal times; '1 year' = month 12); per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Table 3 p-value columns (with baseline and between groups)

exclusions.reason: not tabulated for CMT; the BRVO and CRVO subgroups are extracted so no eye is counted twice
visual acuity is not extracted; medians and IQRs are not admissible

notes: Groups are baseline diagnostic subgroups (BRVO, CRVO) and therefore control groups; the biosimilar is a marketed agent used in routine care, no investigational arm
Statistical analysis: continuous variables as mean ± SD when normally distributed, otherwise median (IQR); Table 3 is labelled Mean ± SD
